auditor_value: (a) t = 40/g = 4 s with g = 10 m/s^2 (4.08 s with g = 9.8); (b) OP = 20t*sqrt(2) = 80*sqrt(2) m = 113.1 m with g = 10 (115.4 m with g = 9.8)
notes: Angle OPQ = 45 deg with Q directly below O gives OQ = QP, so (1/2)gt^2 = 20t; the solution reaches the same condition through the 45 deg incline passing through O (O is the top edge of the incline), which is equivalent. The question does not state g; the solution declares g = 10 m/s^2 in its first step, and the brief treats either value as acceptable. Both common-mistake numbers reproduce: 80 m without the sqrt(2), and gt^2 = 20t gives t = 2 s, OP = 40*sqrt(2) = 56.6 m.
